title: The Man in Linen and the Mark on the Forehead in Jerusalem
description: A vision in which six men with weapons of destruction are ordered to strike down in Jerusalem, while a man dressed in linen places a mark on the foreheads of those who sigh over the city's sin. Judgment is carried out without mercy, but the marked are spared. Ezekiel pleads for mercy for the remnant of the people, but the Lord answers that their guilt is too great and allows their own deeds to fall upon their own heads.
